Maria: Heads-up: just got an escalation from a customer (Acme) — hosted API returning 502/504s across EU region since ~17:22 UTC during cert rotation. Link to logs: https://redwood.inc/issue/1234 :eyes:
Alex: Can you paste the root request id and a small curl repro? Which customer slack thread?
Maria: root req id `r-8f4c2a`; customer provided this curl:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Maria: They observed TLS handshake timeouts then 502s. Attaching edge log snippet:
```
[17:22:13] upstream TLS handshake timeout to 10.42.3.18:443
[17:22:13] resolver lookup for backend.example.edge -> CNAME old-backend.cdn. (TTL 60)
[17:22:14] connection reset by peer
```
SRE Oncall: pinging infra, running `dig +trace` and `openssl s_client` against the target now
Infra Eng: seeing identical spikes on arb-edge-3 and arb-edge-4, looks like some resolvers returned a stale CNAME during the cert swap window
SRE Oncall: `dig` ANSWER shows:
```
backend.example.edge. 60 IN CNAME old-backend.cdn.
```
SRE Oncall: `openssl s_client -connect old-backend.cdn:443 -servername backend.example.edge` returns a cert for old-backend (CN mismatch) and handshake aborts
Alex: hypothesis: DNS propagation lag + cert rotation led to a subset of requests hitting backends with rotated certs that don't match SNI -> handshake fails -> 502/504 upstreams
Maria: customer asking "is this on our side?"
Alex: short answer: yes, it's on our routing/coordination during rotation. Long-term: coordinate low-TTL + staggered cert swaps and validate CNAME/VHOST mapping before cutover
Maria: mitigation options now?
Infra Eng: we can flush internal resolver cache for EU cluster and add a temporary fallback route to the new-backend if TLS handshake fails
Infra Eng: flushing cache on eu-ns-1 now... :white_check_mark:
Deploy-bot: cache flush job queued: job-7724 started
Maria: customer retried and reports 200s returned. They confirm success at ~17:31 UTC :tada:
SRE Oncall: will write a short postmortem and recommended rollout checklist: - reduce DNS TTL before rotation - run CNAME/VHOST probe (dig + s_client) against staged nodes - stagger rotations per region - add handshake-failure fallback route
Alex: filing incident ticket with commands and logs used for repro and mitigation steps
Maria: thanks all — updating the customer and closing this escalation from our side
Support Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0892
